## Reconciliation process

Identify exact competing statements; record both approval states/dates; prefer latest applicable explicit approval, not newest proposal; cite supersession evidence. If unresolved, OWNER REVIEW REQUIRED. Existing protected-home wording is not silently rewritten. See MR_SEWING_UNRESOLVED_POLICY_REGISTER.md for conflicts and missing originals.

## R46 — Floating selection session expiration
Owner decision: **12 November 2026**, “FLOATING SELECTION BUTTON EXPIRATION”; implementation resumed 13 November 2026. Approved for `phase1/customer-journey-repairs` and Cloudflare staging only. Supersedes R44's indefinite retention of unfinished browsing selections; R45 sharing, forms, approved policies and exact-photo handling remain intact.

The floating action appears only on the main Custom Tailoring page, men's/women's landings, their galleries and approved design-detail pages, with at least one browsing selection. It hides immediately elsewhere. The first departure records `leftAt` and `expiresAt = leftAt + 120000` milliseconds in per-tab session storage. Outside refresh does not renew the deadline. Returning before expiration restores browsing; returning at or after expiration clears unfinished browsing selections. Active browsing within the permitted area does not expire. Recheck persisted state on navigation, reads, actions, visibility return and Back/Forward restoration; stale URL snapshots must not override expired or closed sessions.

Continuing from the existing Selected Designs page to fabric choices closes the browsing session and copies all validated design identities, exact photograph URLs, quantities and fabric preferences into a separate quotation snapshot. Flow-tagged existing routes preserve each quotation independently. Back/refresh must not reopen the closed floating action. A deliberate new design selection starts a fresh browsing session without overwriting an active quotation. Explicit Add/Change forks an editable copy; completing one quotation does not delete other quotation flows or a newer browsing selection. No additional form or enquiry provider is introduced.

Sharing retains selections and the existing Terms consent/manual WhatsApp Send. The review page is outside the browsing area, so the same 120-second grace applies until continuation. No automatic customer messages or private customer data in lifecycle identifiers/storage. Browser storage failures are caught with current-page memory and existing validated URL-snapshot transport; persistent history/expiration guarantees cannot be established when the browser refuses all storage. No fingerprinting fallback.

Preserve all customer-facing HTML except selection JavaScript cache references; preserve SEO metadata, canonical destinations, structured data, images, sitemap, robots/staging noindex, CSS, pricing, benefits, OFFER, fabric controls and providers. Historical records remain unchanged. Named original company Sources remain unavailable; this technical decision comes directly from the owner instruction, not an inferred commercial or legal policy. See `SELECTION_EXPIRATION_BRIEF_2026-11-13.md`, `tests/selection-session-expiration.spec.cjs` and `tests/selection_session_preservation.py`. Stop after staging deployment for owner review; main/production remain protected.
